meanings.en: to give away, to hand over
meanings.note: Отдать + dative of the person. Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'дать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to give (away), to hand over', paired with 'отдавать'.

Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'дать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to give (away), to hand over', paired with 'отдавать'.

meanings.en: to carry, deliver something to a place
meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'нести'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to carry to', forming an aspectual pair with 'относить'.

meanings.note: + accusative and dative (кому). Prefix 'пере-' denotes crossing over, repeating, or exceeding a limit (stem 'дать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to pass on, to hand over', paired with 'передавать'.
